title: MatAnyone-E
dek: High-resolution video matting requires preserving fine details, such as hair strands and soft transparency, while maintaining consistency across frames.
body:
High-resolution video matting requires preserving fine details, such as hair strands and soft transparency, while maintaining consistency across frames. Memory-based methods achieve strong matting quality by matching current-frame features with information stored from earlier frames, but this process becomes increasingly costly as resolution grows. We present MatAnyone-E, an efficient extension of MatAnyone 2 that focuses computation where it is most needed.
